preconditions.description: The length of the guessed string s is between 2 and 100.
There are exactly 2n-2 prefix and suffix strings.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(s) <= n-1 for s in prefix_suffix_list)
preconditions.description: Each prefix and suffix string has a length between 1 and n-1.
All characters in prefix and suffix strings are lowercase Latin letters.

postconditions.description: The output string has a length of 2n-2.
The number of 'P' characters equals the number of 'S' characters in the output string.

postconditions.expression: all(c in 'PS' for c in output)
postconditions.description: Each character in the output string is either 'P' or 'S'.
